gloss: to make use of, to put to good use

definitions.gloss: to make use of, to put to good use, to leverage
definitions.explanation: To effectively use skills, experience, resources, or qualities to achieve something.

examples.english: To make use of one's experience.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{特長|とくちょう}を{活|い}かせる{仕事|しごと}を{探|さが}したい。
examples.english: I want to find a job where I can make use of my strengths.

examples.japanese: {留学|りゅうがく}で{身|み}につけた{語学力|ごがくりょく}を{仕事|しごと}に{活|い}かしたい。
examples.english: I want to put the language skills I acquired through studying abroad to use in my work.

notes:
{活|い}かす means to effectively utilize something valuable.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Takes を particle: 〜を{活|い}かす

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経験|けいけん}を{活|い}かす: to make use of experience
- {能力|のうりょく}を{活|い}かす: to leverage one's abilities
- {特長|とくちょう}を{活|い}かす: to put one's strengths to use
- {資源|しげん}を{活|い}かす: to utilize resources

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {活|い}かす: to put to good use (implies effective utilization)
- {使|つか}う: to use (general, neutral)
- {利用|りよう}する: to utilize (formal, broader scope)
